mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.user_no,u.user_real_en_name, CONCAT(GROUP_CONCAT(ur.org_id)) group_id FROM sys_user_uset AS ur INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.uset_id = #{usetId} GROUP BY u.id, u.user_no,u.user_real_en_name
SELECT u.id, u.uset_name, u.state from sys_uset u INNER JOIN sys_user_uset uu ON u.id = uu.uset_id WHERE uu.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=CHAR} AND uu.org_id = #{orgId,jdbcType=CHAR}

SELECT sur.role_id FROM sys_uset su INNER JOIN sys_user_uset suu ON su.id = suu.uset_id INNER JOIN sys_uset_role sur ON sur.uset_id = su.id WHERE suu.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND suu.org_id = #{groupId, jdbcType=CHAR}
